results.trace: pnpm vitest run --config vitest.config.ts tests/verify/R2-1.test.ts. Steps: set racer.finished.hay-loop, setup(), click Pine Ridge (checked), click Race (trackId forest-ridge), remove the key, game.showMenu(). The Pine Ridge card is aria-disabled='true' and still aria-checked='true'. The test fails at `expect(pine.getAttribute('aria-checked')).not.toBe('true')` (received 'true'). Cause: select() at start-screen.ts:105-108 sets the lock, then pick() returns early at :44 without moving `selected`, and show() at :100-103 only refreshes.
results.reason: Reproduced. A card that is locked again stays checked, and RACE would start the locked track. That breaks the plan audit's rule that a locked card is never checked. The fix is small: re-validate the selection in show().

results.trace: grep finds finishedKey and hasFinished only in src/content/tracks.ts. hasFinished is the default reader for isTrackLocked.
results.reason: This is not duplication, and there is no behavioural defect. The spec asks tracks.ts to provide a reader/writer for racer.finished.<id>, and whether these helpers are exported is a style preference.

results.trace: I compared start--menu.png with S6. The names do wrap ('BRAMBLE/BENDS', 'DUST/BOWL'). Each card's content box is about 93px, while 'BRAMBLE BENDS' at 22px 900 italic needs roughly 135px. The suggested left-padding change frees only about 2px per card.
results.reason: The S6 mockup shows three cards with short names, not four. No UI_RULES rule requires one-line names. The suggested nowrap would clip the names and fail AC10's scrollWidth ≤ clientWidth check, so the fix would break the spec.

results.trace: game.ts:199 saves only when racers[0] goes from unfinished to finished. Searching tests for racer.finished finds only pine-ridge-unlock.test.ts:26/30 and setItem calls in next/next-race. Every finish in the game tests goes through finishRace (pine-ridge-helpers.ts:36), which drives car 0 to the finish. No test runs a Hay Loop race where only a bot finishes and then checks that racer.finished.hay-loop is absent. So the mutant `racers.some(x => x.finishTick != null)` would save the same key in every existing test, and they would all still pass.
results.reason: There is a real coverage gap for behaviour the spec states outright (AC6: 'When car 0 finishes'; 'A player finish saves the key'). No test pins that a bot's finish does not unlock Pine Ridge.

results.trace: The AC7 test (pine-ridge-unlock.test.ts:41) goes finishRace hay-loop → Next race. nextTrackId('hay-loop') wraps to 'bends', so Quit runs showMenu → select('bends'), never select('forest-ridge'). In next-race.test.ts the key is set and NEXT RACE starts forest-ridge, but the test never returns to the menu. Elsewhere the key is set before setup(), so the constructor's refresh() already unlocks the card. No test in tests/ calls .select(). If start-screen.ts:107 (setLocked in select) were removed, then after the unlock (racing forest-ridge, then showMenu), pick('forest-ridge') would see the stale locked=true and return. show() would then unlock the card but leave the previous track checked. All tests would still pass.
results.reason: There is a real coverage gap. Nothing tests that select() re-reads the lock when the menu returns to a track that unlocked after the last menu show.
